title: cyphomandra fragilis
intro: Cyphomandra fragilis, commonly known as the Tree Tomato or Tamarillo, is a type of flowering plant native to the Andean region of South America. The health benefits of Cyphomandra fragilis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastritis and ulcers. The bioactive constituents of Cyphomandra fragilis include vitamin C, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
